units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for officials of 1 per cent of the initial (maximum) contract price, but not less than five thousand and not more than thirty thousand roubles; and for legal entities, 1 per cent of the initial (maximum) contract price, but not less than fifty thousand and not more than two hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 7.30.2 · “shall entail an administrative fine for officials of 1 per cent…”
